column4: Description
Sign-up, login/logout and role-based access for students and admins.
Creating, listing, editing and searching college and tech events.
Students reserving and cancelling seats, with seat limits enforced.
Admins view and manage the registrations of each event.
Confirmation and other emails, with a delivery log.
CI pipeline, automated testing and deployment.

*User story*
As the development team, we want every push and pull request linted, type-checked and unit-tested automatically, so that broken code never reaches main.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given a pull request is opened, then GitHub Actions runs lint, type check and unit tests and shows pass or fail on the PR.
* Given CI fails, then the PR cannot be merged.
* Test results and coverage are saved as build artifacts.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want to create an account with my name, email and password, so that I can register for events.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I am on the sign-up page, when I submit a valid name, a new email and a password of 8 or more characters, then my account is created as a STUDENT and I am logged in.
* Given the email is already used, when I submit, then I see "Email already registered" and no account is created.
* Given a field is empty or the email is invalid, when I submit, then I see an error next to that field.
* The password is stored hashed with bcrypt, never as plain text.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

column3: US-02 Log in and log out with roles
column4:
*User story*
As a registered user, I want to log in and log out, so that only I can see my registrations and only admins can manage events.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given correct credentials, when I log in, then a student lands on the Events page and an admin lands on the Admin dashboard.
* Given a wrong email or password, then I see "Invalid email or password", without revealing which one was wrong.
* Given I am a student, when I open any /admin page, then I am sent away and cannot see it.
* Given I click Log out, then my session ends and protected pages ask me to log in again.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As an admin, I want to create an event with a title, description, category (College or Tech), venue, date and time, registration deadline and capacity, so that students can find it and register.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given all fields are valid, when I save, then the event appears in the public events list.
* Given the deadline is after the event start, or capacity is below 1, when I save, then I see a validation error and nothing is saved.
* Given the event date is in the past, then I see "Event date must be in the future".

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want to see upcoming events with their date, venue and seats left, so that I can choose which one to attend.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given published future events exist, when I open Events, then I see them sorted by date with seats left shown.
* Past and cancelled events do not appear.
* Given an event is full, then it shows "Full" and its Register button is disabled.
* Clicking an event opens its details page.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want to register for an event in one click, so that my seat is reserved.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I am logged in and the event is open with a free seat, when I click Register, then my registration is CONFIRMED and seats left drops by 1.
* Given I am already registered for this event, then I see "Already registered" and no second registration is made.
* Given the event is full, then I see "Event full".
* Given the registration deadline has passed, then I see "Registration closed".
* Given two students try to take the last seat at the same moment, then exactly one succeeds.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

column3: US-08 View and cancel my registrations
column4:
*User story*
As a student, I want to see my registrations and cancel one, so that I can manage my plans and free my seat for someone else.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I have registrations, when I open My Registrations, then I see each event with its date and my status.
* Given the event has not started, when I cancel, then my status becomes CANCELLED and seats left rises by 1.
* Given I cancelled earlier, then I can register again while seats remain.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As the development team, we want an automated browser test of the main path, so that we know sign-up and registration still work after every change.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given CI runs, then headless Chrome signs up a new student, registers for a seeded event and sees the confirmation.
* Given the test fails, then a screenshot is saved as an artifact.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want a confirmation email when I register, so that I have proof of my seat and the event details.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given my registration succeeds, then an email reaches my address with the event title, date, venue and my registration ID.
* Given the email server fails, then my registration still succeeds and the email is logged as FAILED.
* Every send attempt is recorded in the notification log with its status and time.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As an admin, I want to resend a confirmation email, so that students whose first email failed still receive it.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given a registration whose email status is FAILED, when I click Resend, then a new attempt is made and logged.
* Given the resend succeeds, then the email status shows SENT.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

column3: US-09 Admin views registrations per event
column4:
*User story*
As an admin, I want to see who registered for each event, so that I know who is attending.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I open an event in Admin, then I see each registrant's name, email, registration time, status and email status (SENT or FAILED).
* The page shows confirmed registrations against capacity, for example "42 / 60".

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As an admin, I want to remove a registration, so that I can handle duplicates or no-shows and free the seat.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I click Remove and confirm, then the registration becomes CANCELLED and seats left rises by 1.
* Given I dismiss the confirmation, then nothing changes.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

column3: US-05 Admin edits or cancels an event
column4:
*User story*
As an admin, I want to edit or cancel an event, so that students always see correct information.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I change details and save, then the event page shows the new details.
* Given I set capacity below the number already registered, then I see an error and nothing is saved.
* Given I cancel an event, then it disappears from the public list and new registrations are blocked.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want to search events by name and filter them by category and date, so that I can find relevant events quickly.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given I type text in search, then only events whose title contains it are shown, ignoring upper and lower case.
* Given I pick the Tech category, then only Tech events are shown.
* Given nothing matches, then I see "No events found".

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As the Product Owner, I want the acceptance criteria of every Must story checked by browser tests, so that we can demo with confidence.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Ten browser scenarios pass in CI: sign up and log in; browse with seats shown; register with email verified; duplicate blocked; full event blocked; cancel frees seat; admin creates event; admin removes registration; student blocked from /admin; filter events.
* An HTML test report is produced for the project report.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

column3: US-14 Email when an event is cancelled
column4:
*User story*
As a student, I want an email if an event I registered for is cancelled, so that I do not turn up for nothing.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given an admin cancels an event, then every CONFIRMED registrant gets a cancellation email, logged per person.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests

*User story*
As a student, I want to join a waitlist when an event is full, so that I get a seat automatically if someone cancels.

*Acceptance criteria*
* Given an event is full, when I click Join waitlist, then I am added in the order I joined.
* Given a confirmed student cancels, then the first person on the waitlist is confirmed and emailed.

*Definition of Done*
* Merged through a PR with 1 approval from another member
* CI green
* Owner has checked every acceptance criterion
* Logic covered by tests
